EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice Under Section 7
My Ref. No.: 6/3/7/15/5/7/8. Ref. No. of the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land
and Irrigation : 4-3/10/2020/MV/109.

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for Moragahakanda/Kaluganga Development Project.

Description of the land to be acquired : Allotment of land depicted in Sheet No. 01 in Block No. 03 in Cadastral Map No. 310208 made by Surveyor General on 31.12.2024, Situated in Medapihilla Village in No. E407C, Medapihilla Grama Niladhari Division in Divisional Secretary’s Division of Naula in Matale District, Central Province.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
(Published by Authority)
PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
01. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Kendagolla, Meegolla; Use of land at present : Scrub; Claimed by : M. N. G. Ukku Amma; Land Extent: 0.4359 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing before me at Divisional Secretariat, Naula on 30.05.2025 at 11.00 a.m.

And are hereby requested to notify me in writing with two copies on or before 22.05.2025 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of computation of such amount.
S. Vijayakumar, Divisional Secretary, Naula. At the Divisional Secretariat, Naula, 29th April, 2025. EOG 05 - 0017

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460), AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT
(AMENDMENT) No. 28 OF 1964
Notice Under Section 7
My Ref. No.: ARA/LND/ACQVI/D3/65. Ministry of Irrigation, Lands, livestock resources and
Agriculture Ref. No. : 4-3/18/2019/WS/522.
I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose.

Description of land or servitude to be acquired : An allotment of land is named Ambadeniya Gavilipitiya about 0.1035 Hectare in extent which is depicted as Lot 01 of Cadastral Map Number 610383 in the plan and dated 11.02.2025 made by the Surveyor General and situated in the Village of Narangammana, in the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 45, D. Narangammana, in the Minor Division of Ganhatha Palatha, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Aranayaka in the District of Kegalle, in Sabaragamuwa Province and boundaries are as follows :
01. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Ambadeniyawatta, Gavilipitiya; Extent: 0.1035 Hectare.
Boundaries : North by : Ambadeniya watta and Road; East by : Road and Road (Pradeshiya Sabha); South by : Road (Pradeshiya Sabha) and Ambadeniya Watta); West by : Ambadeniya Watta.

Other particulars : Land has been acquired under Section 38 (A) of the Land Acquisition Act. Kegalle plantation Company, Maharagama is the preliminary claimant. For the completion of land acquisition activities.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land on which servitude is to be acquired or any other relevance to the land should appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing before me on the 18th day of June 2025 at 10.00 a.m. at the Divisional Secretariat, Aranayaka.

Further they should notify me in writing (in duplicate) on or before 11.06.2025 the nature of their interest, the particulars of claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands the amount of compensation and details of the computation such amount.
Shamali Piyatissa, Divisional Secretary, Aranayaka. At the Divisional Secretariat, Aranayaka, 30th April, 2025. EOG 05 - 0018
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice Under Section 7
My Ref. No.: 6/3/7/15/8/2/45. Ref. No. of the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land
and Irrigation : 4-3/10/2019/MV/183.

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the government intends to acquire the following land which is required for Moragahakanda/Kaluganga Development Project.

Description of the land to be acquired : Allotment of land depicted in Sheet No. 01 in Block No. 01 in Cadastral Map No. 310224 made by Surveyor General on 31.12.2024, Situated in Rajawela Village in No. E409A, Rajawela Grama Niladhari Division in Divisional Secretary’s Division of Naula in Matale District in Central Province.
01. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Rajawela Gammedda; Use of land at present : Paddy field; Claimed by : M. A. Kumara Herath; Land Extent: 0.1049 Hectare.
02. Lot No. 02 Name of the Land: —; Use of land at present : Canal (abandoned); Claimed by : State; Land Extent: 0.0022 Hectare.
03. Lot No. 03 Name of the Land: Rajawela Gammedda; Use of land at present : Compound, permanent building and mixed crop cultivation; Claimed by : M. A. Kumara Herath; Land Extent: 0.1014 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid lands to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing before me at Divisional Secretariat, Naula on 29.05.2025 at 11.00 a.m.

And are hereby requested to notify me in writing with two copies on or before 21.05.2025 the nature of their interests in the land/lands, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands servitudes, the amount of compensation and the details of computation of such amount.
S. Vijayakumar, Divisional Secretary, Naula. At the Divisional Secretariat, Naula, 29th April, 2025. EOG 05 - 0019
